question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: a JSON-RPC tools/list (jsonrpc 2.0, id 2), Accept application/json and text/event-stream, no Authorization header and no preceding initialize

decoded.body: byte-identical to the initialize refusal of two seconds earlier: the same 108 bytes, the same -31996, the same id null
decoded.why-this-is-a-separate-record: plenty of hosted MCP servers answer tools/list anonymously while gating tools/call, so 'this one does not' is a measurement and not an inference from the initialize refusal
decoded.not-measured: the tool list itself. This entry's tool-count, schema and annotation cells are empty because of this response, and a count read from the vendor's documentation would be the vendor's claim rather than this server's answer

finding: With no credentials on 2026-10-08 at 12:19:18Z, tools/list on Zapier's hosted MCP endpoint answered 401 with a body byte-identical to the initialize refusal two seconds earlier. The server lists no tools to a keyless caller, which is why this registry entry has no tool list: not because none was looked for.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -X POST https://mcp.zapier.com/api/mcp/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}'
